H1 is a faded earlier head with an old check result, disconnected from the current M1 result; label "An old result is not a result for the new target". Strict base freshness and stale-approval dismissal depend on repository settings." Avoid claiming skipped or neutral required checks can never be accepted; use the word accepted rather than only green/success. Small short scope "B1 / H1 / H2 / M1 are symbolic identifiers, not observed SHAs." No actual PR/CI screenshots or fake success badge.

Required checks can be accepted in successful, skipped or neutral states according to GitHub policy, so do not imply all jobs must have executed successfully.
